Rail, bus and Kaup render as separate AS-IS schedule families. Explicit return, cutoff/last-train, controlled forecast and compact Kaup states were reviewed; QA experiment treatments remain non-production evidence.

alternatives_considered: candidate research states promoted to production
capsules.conclusion: Amber research collectibles and Focus Egg prototypes are visually and behaviorally separate systems. Empty/found/dialog and locked/eligible/found/unavailable states were reviewed; they are not merged.
